parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans expression, no border document friction and no facility ban are documented, and Pride now proceeds with police protection — courts even struck down local propaganda bans. But the traveller-facing record is dominated by weak enforcement plus deep social hostility: hate speech is a serious, unanswered problem with election-period peaks and impunity; discrimination is reported as commonplace; a trans woman's bank denial was confirmed yet remedy unproven; 79% social-distance figures signal pervasive rejection (tier 3 with thin recourse). Weighted heavily but contingently: the 2025-corroborated prison case shows a state institution isolating and strip-searching a trans detainee by birth sex, defended by the administration and unremedied. Occupied-region propaganda law adds an unsourced layer. Protections are largely paper. Net: elevated risk.
